title: MSFS Marketplace: 12 New Missions & Global Airline Overhaul (May 2026)
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace just received a massive wave of new content for May 2026! From high-stakes landing challenges in the Canadian wilderness to a complete overhaul of global airline and airport schedules, we are breaking down the 12 featured results you need to see.

In this video, we dive into the latest releases from Perfect Flight and VA Systems to see which ones belong in your hangar.

What’s Inside:

- The Headliners: Perfect Flight’s "12 Legs: Wizz Air Spring 2026" (IFR missions with 100+ tracked events).  
- Advanced Challenges: 20 intense landing challenges across Canada—from the frozen tundra of Nunavut to the foggy shores of Newfoundland.  
- Global Airline Refresh: Real-world Winter 2025/26 schedules for carriers like Air Transat, Eurowings, Air India, and El Al.
- Hub Overhaul: Updated airport schedules for major hubs including Helsinki (EFHK), Philadelphia (KPHL), and Shanghai (ZSSS).

Aircraft Highlight: * Airbus A320neo / A321LR (Required for specific mission packs).

Whether you’re a bush pilot mastering the Canadian backcountry or a commercial captain flying accurate 2026 routes, this update has something for you.

✈️ Which region are you flying first? Let me know in the comments!
